name: WeVisForensics (4B LoRA adapters)

lineage.how_derived: five rank-64 LoRA adapters (main investigator plus visual-appearance, physical-consistency, common-sense and on-screen-text inspectors) trained with DTPO; the card also describes speech-content and voice-profile inspectors without releasing adapters for them

purpose: Self-evolving multi-agent detector of AI-generated video: a main investigator coordinates forensic inspector sub-agents (paper arXiv 2611.21373).
